description: NaBH₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four H atoms. There is one shorter (1.22 Å) and three longer (1.23 Å) B-H bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four H atoms. All B-H bond lengths are 1.23 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one B atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one B atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one B atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one B atom.
